# Collapsible > Accessible disclosure primitive with measured open and close motion. This file matches the installed `collapsible` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/collapsible.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/collapsible.md`. ## npm dependencies - `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0` ## Registry dependencies - `core` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/collapsible-knobs`: `collapsibleKnobs`, types `CollapsibleKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/collapsible`: `Collapsible`, `CollapsibleTrigger`, `CollapsibleContent`, types `CollapsibleProps`, `CollapsibleTriggerProps`, `CollapsibleContentProps` ## Composition ### Anatomy ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { ChevronRightIcon } from "lucide-react"; import { Collapsible, CollapsibleContent, CollapsibleTrigger } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/collapsible"; import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; export function PrimitiveCollapsibleExample() { return ( Reasoning steps
Parsed the request and grouped the constraints. Checked each candidate against the contract. Kept the smallest change that satisfied all of them.
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `collapsible` - `content`: `data-state` (`closed` | `open`) - `root`: `data-state` (`closed` | `open`) - `trigger`: `data-panel-open` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### collapsible - `--cui-collapsible-trigger-radius`: `var(--radius-control)` - `--cui-collapsible-trigger-hover-background`: `var(--hover-fill)` - `--cui-collapsible-trigger-padding-inline`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 2)` - `--cui-collapsible-trigger-padding-block`: `0px` - `--cui-collapsible-trigger-font-size`: `var(--text-label)` - `--cui-collapsible-trigger-foreground`: `var(--foreground)` - `--cui-collapsible-trigger-hover-foreground`: `var(--foreground)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/collapsible - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/collapsible.json
